notes: Reviewed PvP death rules after the 17 June 2026 Trouver rework and 8 July fixes.
Exact item IDs preserve locked, unlocked, ornamented and charged state. Missing untradeable IDs must remain UNKNOWN.
replacementItems is the owner replacement loss, not necessarily killer loot. REPAIR/LOCKABLE entries add lost tradeable kits separately.
Unknown charge quantities are not encoded as zero. Entry fees and stored contents are accounted separately.
